resolutions.researcher_notes: The existing ref (https://southernstar.com/gis-maps/) is NOT confirmed dead: url_verifier and a manual fetch both return HTTP 200, but the response is a bot-block/challenge interstitial, not the real page -- per the brief's rule ('a blocked fetch is not a deletion'), this is unreachable, not confirmed 404/410, so I am not carrying a DEAD_LINK classification forward and am instead resolving with replacement sources. Two distinct-publisher sources agree that Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc. is wholly/fully owned as a single entity, matching the sheet's Owner1 = 'Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc' at 100.00%: (1) Southern Star Central Corp.'s own Form 10-K for FY2013 (SEC EDGAR, CIK 0001260349, filed 2014-03-28): 'references to the Company, refer to Southern Star Central Corp. and to its wholly-owned subsidiary, Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc., or Central.' (2) La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec's (CDPQ) own press release ('La Caisse enters partnership to acquire Southern Star Central Corp.', dated May 1, 2015 -- note the seed citation's context line mislabels this as '2017-03-14'; the page's own dateline reads May 1, 2015): 'La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec (CDPQ) has partnered with GE Unit GE Energy Financial Services to jointly acquire Southern Star Central Corporation from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure. The company has full ownership of Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc. (SSCGP), which operates a FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission)-regulated natural gas pipeline system in the United States.' The SEC filing (self-reported by the pipeline's then-parent) and the CDPQ press release (an unrelated third-party institutional investor, describing an acquisition of the parent from yet another distinct party, Morgan Stanley Infrastructure) are two genuinely distinct publishers/origins agreeing that 'Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc.' is held as a single, wholly/fully owned entity -- consistent with GEM's single 100% Owner1 record (both sources describe the ultimate/parent-level ownership chain changing hands over the years -- MSIP to GE/CDPQ in 2015 -- while the PIPELINE-OWNING ENTITY itself, which is what GEM's Owner1 field records, remains 'Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc.' throughout; that entity-level fact is what these two sources corroborate, not a claim that CDPQ or MSIP is the sheet's Owner1). Tier high, independent=true. Also confirmed via Wayback (CDX API) that southernstar.com/about-us/ has live captures from 2019-2022 that identify the organization as 'Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline' consistent with the entity name, though those captures carry no explicit ownership-percentage statement so were not used as a primary citation here.
